changes: About matches MyPDF’s centered card, with version details, support links and separate What’s New and Check for Updates actions.
What’s New has a refreshed layout with clear release highlights, a version badge and a dedicated update card, even offline.
Release notes appear once after an upgrade and remain available from the app menu.
Optional daily update checks show a quiet notice when an update is available. Background checks are off by default.
macos: The macOS top MyImage menu opens the same About dialog as the in-app menu, with What’s New and Check for Updates actions.
Check GitHub for a newer Mac version and build, then open the matching Mac download.
windows: Store-installed copies check Microsoft Store for updates available to this installation. Open the Store to update.
